writing.title: How I Have Changed
writing.prompt_cn: 每个人都在成长中改变。请以 "How I Have Changed" 为题,写一篇约80词的短文,描述你和过去相比的变化。
key_points: 你过去是什么样(外貌/性格/习惯,至少两点,用 used to)
useful_expressions: I used to be / used to + 动词原形
I'm happy that I have changed
writing.sample: I have changed a lot in the past few years. I used to be a short and shy boy. I didn't use to talk to new people, and I was even afraid of speaking in class. But now I am taller and much more confident. Joining the school basketball team helped me change. I made many friends and learned to believe in myself. I'm really happy that I am not the shy child I used to be.
writing.sample_cn: 在过去几年里我变化很大。我以前是个又矮又害羞的男孩,以前不跟陌生人说话,甚至害怕在课上发言。但现在我长高了,也自信多了。参加学校篮球队帮我改变。我交了很多朋友,学会了相信自己。我很高兴自己不再是从前那个害羞的孩子。

scoring.content: 涵盖4个要点(过去样子≥2点/现在/原因/感受)
scoring.language: 正确使用 used to / didn't use to;时态过去与现在对比清晰
